name: weekday_offset
description: Find the weekday one or two days after a named weekday, with few-shot demonstrations and matched marker-copy controls.
generator_code:
import random,json
random.seed(0)
days=['Monday','Tuesday','Wednesday','Thursday','Friday','Saturday','Sunday'];items=[];controls=[]
p='Find the resulting weekday.\n1 day after Monday is Tuesday.\n2 days after Friday is Sunday.\n1 day after Sunday is Monday.\n'
cp='Read the marker.\n1 day after Monday; marker red. Marker: red\n2 days after Friday; marker blue. Marker: blue\n1 day after Sunday; marker gold. Marker: gold\n'
for i in range(84):
 d=i%7;n=random.choice([1,2]);tag=random.choice(['red','blue','gold','green'])
 items.append({'prompt':p+f'{n} '+('day' if n==1 else 'days')+f' after {days[d]} is','answer':' '+days[(d+n)%7]})
 controls.append({'prompt':cp+f'{n} '+('day' if n==1 else 'days')+f' after {days[d]}; marker {tag}. Marker:','answer':' '+tag})
json.dump({'items':items,'control':controls},open('/work/skill.json','w'))
